QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_63

question.text: Under the Corporate Model, how many PFMs can a subscriber choose under Active Choice?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the Corporate Model Tier I, a subscriber can select up to 3 pension funds under Active Choice. The Trap: The trap is to assume Corporate is unique. All Citizens Model Tier I and Tier II under all models can also select up to 3 pension funds under Active Choice, in accordance with the asset classes (except the Alternate Asset Class). Do not state that All Citizens typically uses only one PFM. Note: Frame the multi-PFM facility as a property of Active Choice across the supported models, not as a Corporate-only feature.
